tiles.title: tapo-onboarding
tiles.text: tapo-onboarding is open-source tooling for onboarding modern TP-Link Tapo cameras without using the vendor cloud, including support for newer v3 encrypted provisioning.

tiles.title: Stateful
tiles.text: Stateful is a Pebble smartwatch application providing a tile-based interface for controlling RESTful APIs with minimal user interaction.

tiles.title: restate-go
tiles.text: restate-go is a local-first home automation platform written in Go, designed to provide cloudless automation without dependence on external services.

tiles.title: Snowdon II WiFi
tiles.text: Snowdon II WiFi is a Raspberry Pi Pico based modchip adding Wi-Fi and a RESTful API to a Majority Snowdon II soundbar by driving its infrared interface and inferring state from its status LED.
